# Call with Priya Nandakumar, Nandakumar Design — 14 Aug

Found her through Marcus. She runs a three-person studio, bills around $8k/mo.

She said: "I spent forty minutes trying to figure out how to add my logo and then
gave up and sent the invoice from Wave instead." That is the third person this
month who has mentioned branding as the thing that stopped them.

Also worth noting, the invoice editor feels sluggish when I have more than twenty
line items. Marcus said the same thing in July.

She would pay $49/mo if it handled recurring retainers. I did not push on that.

MRR is at 3620 now, up from last month.

I think we should probably stop the redesign and do onboarding, but I want to
sleep on it.
